angle: the mark or trace the process leaves behind
subject: Only the trail the colony has left on the stone, one line weight throughout: every birth since the first spore is a line from parent to child, worn through where that cell has died, jogged where it stepped a half step, and the two lines grown this tick are the bright ones.
controls: grow: shape. A probe reaches from each living margin cell towards the free cell furthest from the start, a few px at 0 to about 20 px at 100.
decay: shape. Lines into dead cells are dashed and their gaps open with decay, so at 100 the old centre of the trail is mostly worn away.
seed: count. Small rings mark where spores will land, each with a dashed fall above it, 0 to 8.
scale: shape. A link that moved a half step has a small jog in it; a wider step is a plain bow. Each mode moves the jogs; the pentatonics have none.
risks: At rest it's sparse (about 20 lines) and doesn't say lichen or lattice without the motion; the shape of the trail is the colony's history, not its body, so where the colony is alive has to be read from brightness. The jogs are 9 px features and may sit near scale's floor. A long run grows a dense trail that needs a history limit (the last N births) for the node budget. Muted: every line drops to G3 and the bright births go out.
